test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are many methods adopted to prevent transmission of HIV/AIDS. Which of the stated ones is INCORRECT?

options.text: The instruments used for ear piercing, acupuncture, etc., must be sterilised before use.
Transmission by way of drug abuse specially through sharing of needles must be prevented
Prevent HIV infected mosquito bite by using mosquito net.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Prevent HIV infected mosquito bite by using mosquito net**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• HIV/AIDS is linked to both poverty and economic instability__

 __
 
• Studies have shown a strong correlation between poverty__ and the prevalence of __HIV/AIDS__.
 
• Economic instability often leads to increased vulnerability due to lack of access to healthcare, education, and prevention resources.
 
• Poverty-stricken areas tend to have higher rates of risk behaviors such as unprotected sex, which increases the likelihood of HIV transmission.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• HIV/AIDS in urban vs. rural populations__

 __
 
• HIV/AIDS affects both urban and rural populations, although the distribution may vary based on factors like migration, healthcare access, and education.
 
 
 
• Modes of HIV transmission__
 __
 
• HIV is primarily transmitted through unprotected sexual contact, sharing of contaminated needles, and from mother to child during childbirth or breastfeeding.
 
• Transmission through blood transfusion, although possible, is less common due to stringent screening processes.
 
 
 
• Prevalence of HIV/AIDS in Indian states__
 
 
• The prevalence of HIV/AIDS is not uniformly increasing in all Indian states; some states have seen stabilization or even reduction in new cases due to effective interventions and awareness programs.
